routes.classificationDefinition: A garbage pile, overflowing public bin, accumulated household waste, or missed municipal waste collection.
excludes: Deliberate dumping at an undesignated public location
A generally dirty public area without a specific waste pile or overflow
routes.scopeNote: Council duty covers cleansing public streets and places. Nandurbar's internal handling desk remains unconfirmed.

officialSource.title: Maharashtra Municipal Councils, Nagar Panchayats and Industrial Townships Act, 1965

routes.classificationDefinition: Waste being dumped or repeatedly left at an undesignated public location.
excludes: An overflowing public bin or missed municipal collection
General public-area dirt without an identifiable dumping event or dump site
routes.scopeNote: Council cleansing duty and the statutory prohibition on depositing dust or refuse support authority-level routing.

officialSource.title: Maharashtra Municipal Councils, Nagar Panchayats and Industrial Townships Act, 1965

routes.classificationDefinition: A generally dirty or unclean public space without a specific garbage overflow or illegal-dumping event.
excludes: A pile or overflow of collected waste
Dumping at an undesignated public location
routes.scopeNote: General cleansing duty for public streets and places. Added in v0.2 to distinguish broad cleanliness complaints from garbage overflow and illegal dumping.

officialSource.title: Maharashtra Municipal Councils, Nagar Panchayats and Industrial Townships Act, 1965

routes.classificationDefinition: A municipal or public toilet that is dirty, damaged, blocked, unusable, or otherwise unsanitary.
excludes: A toilet inside a private home or private commercial property
General street drainage or sewage overflow outside a public toilet
routes.scopeNote: Council duty covers public latrines, privies and urinals.

officialSource.title: Maharashtra Municipal Councils, Nagar Panchayats and Industrial Townships Act, 1965

routes.classificationDefinition: Stagnant or insanitary water, visible mosquito breeding, or a request for municipal mosquito-control action including a request for fogging.
excludes: A private indoor pest-control request without a public-health condition
Smoke, haze, or fog unrelated to mosquito-control activity
routes.scopeNote: Council powers cover stagnant or insanitary water and mosquito breeding. The treatment method remains a municipal decision.

knownLimitations.citizenMessage: The Municipal Council may choose the appropriate mosquito-control treatment; fogging is not promised.

officialSource.title: Maharashtra Municipal Councils, Nagar Panchayats and Industrial Townships Act, 1965

routes.classificationDefinition: A dead-animal carcass in a public street, public place, or other location requiring municipal disposal.
excludes: An injured or living animal requiring rescue
A carcass-management issue wholly inside private premises
routes.scopeNote: The Act authorises council provision and agency for disposal of dead-animal carcasses.

officialSource.title: Maharashtra Municipal Councils, Nagar Panchayats and Industrial Townships Act, 1965

routes.classificationDefinition: A problem with municipal drinking-water availability, interruption, pressure, leakage, or apparent quality.
excludes: A private plumbing fault confined to one property
A non-municipal water source whose operator is known to be another authority
routes.scopeNote: Council duty covers obtaining sufficient and wholesome water. The operating body for every part of Nandurbar's network has not been independently confirmed.

knownLimitations.citizenMessage: If another public body operates this water connection, responsibility may sit outside the Municipal Council.

officialSource.title: Maharashtra Municipal Councils, Nagar Panchayats and Industrial Townships Act, 1965

routes.classificationDefinition: A pothole, broken surface, collapse, or other physical damage on a public road.
excludes: An obstruction on an otherwise undamaged road
Damage known to be on a privately maintained road
routes.scopeNote: Council duty covers construction and maintenance of municipal public streets. Road ownership must be checked where the road may be maintained by another authority.

knownLimitations.citizenMessage: If this is a state or national highway, responsibility may sit with PWD or the relevant highway authority.

officialSource.title: Maharashtra Municipal Councils, Nagar Panchayats and Industrial Townships Act, 1965

routes.classificationDefinition: Overflowing, blocked, damaged, or leaking public drains or sewers, including sewage entering a public street.
excludes: A private plumbing blockage confined to one property
Clean-water leakage without a drainage or sewage condition
routes.scopeNote: Council duty covers drains, sewers, drainage and sewerage works. Public Works is shown as the likely primary desk, but cleaning and structural work may be split internally.

knownLimitations.citizenMessage: Drain cleaning and structural repair may be handled by different municipal departments; Nandurbar's internal allocation is not yet confirmed.

officialSource.title: Maharashtra Municipal Councils, Nagar Panchayats and Industrial Townships Act, 1965

routes.classificationDefinition: A physical obstruction blocking or materially restricting movement on a public street or public place.
excludes: A pothole or damaged road surface without a separate obstruction
A traffic-enforcement complaint without a physical civic obstruction
routes.scopeNote: Council duty covers removal of obstructions in public streets and places. Persistent commercial encroachment may follow a different internal municipal process.

knownLimitations.citizenMessage: Persistent commercial encroachment may be handled through a different municipal desk; Nandurbar's internal allocation is not yet confirmed.

officialSource.title: Maharashtra Municipal Councils, Nagar Panchayats and Industrial Townships Act, 1965

routes.classificationDefinition: A municipal streetlight lamp that is not working, stays on incorrectly, flickers, or otherwise fails to light a public street.
excludes: A leaning electricity pole, sagging conductor, transformer fault, or wider distribution-network failure
Lighting wholly inside private property
routes.scopeNote: Council duty covers lighting public streets, places and buildings. Electricity-distribution infrastructure remains outside this route.

knownLimitations.citizenMessage: A leaning pole, exposed or sagging wire, transformer fault, or wider power failure may be an MSEDCL matter rather than a Municipal Council streetlight complaint.

officialSource.title: Maharashtra Municipal Councils, Nagar Panchayats and Industrial Townships Act, 1965
